issue.title: Revalidating Tier-1 index reads re-stat every hidden row and take minutes
issue.description:
A revalidating Tier-1 artifact-index read runs `repair_stale_rows_for_query`, which re-stats every `hidden = 1` row. On this host that is 4,507 hidden rows.

While diagnosing Agents-tab completed-row starvation (`plan:202608/agents_window_completed_starvation.md`), the recovery load `source=tier1_index_revalidate` in `~/.sase/logs/tui_agent_loads.jsonl` on 2026-08-28 took **137 s** of disk time (`agents=316`). A cached unwindowed read of the same visible set is ~500 ms; the extra minutes are the hidden-row restat, not the absence of a window.

ACE arms this revalidate after each cached Tier-1 load and fires it 2 s after input goes quiet (at most every 300 s). After a TUI restart that is the path that eventually restores DONE history — and why the missing rows "reappeared while I was typing".

The starvation tale now takes one cached unwindowed prefix-completion read instead of waiting on this revalidate. The 137 s hidden-row restat remains.

## Bug

- **Location:** `crates/sase_core/src/agent_scan/index.rs` (`repair_stale_rows_for_query`)

Restart `sase ace` on a home dir whose index has thousands of `hidden = 1` rows. After first paint, wait for `source=tier1_index_revalidate` in `~/.sase/logs/tui_agent_loads.jsonl`. On this host that load restatted 4,507 hidden rows and ran for 137 s.

The Agents tab stays on a bounded prefix (or waits minutes) for a revalidate that is supposed to be a quiet background freshness pass. Typing during the restat is how the missing DONE rows used to reappear.

Do not fix this by skipping revalidate entirely or by making every ACE refresh unwindowed. Cached reads must stay read-only; the defect is restatting hidden rows on the revalidate path.

task_type_fields.impact: The post-startup revalidate that is supposed to be a quiet freshness pass blocks disk for minutes; DONE history used to reappear only when that 137s load finished.
task_type_fields.repro: Restart sase ace on a home dir with thousands of hidden=1 index rows. After first paint, wait for source=tier1_index_revalidate in ~/.sase/logs/tui_agent_loads.jsonl. On this host that load restatted 4507 hidden rows and ran 137s.
